```python
def _start_point(H, g, A, b, eq, x_feas):
    """Mehrotra-style starting point from the equality-relaxed solution."""
    n = H.shape[0]; m = A.shape[0]
    eqr = np.flatnonzero(eq)
    ner = int(eqr.size)
    if ner:
        K = np.zeros((n + ner, n + ner))
        K[:n,:n] = H; K[:n,n:] = A[eqr].T; K[n:,:n] = A[eqr]
        rhs = np.concatenate([-g, b[eqr]])
        try: sol = np.linalg.solve(K, rhs)
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError: sol = None
    else:
        try: sol = np.linalg.solve(H, -g)
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError: sol = None
    if sol is None or not np.all(np.isfinite(sol)):
        return x_feas, None
    xt = sol[:n]
    yt = np.zeros(m)
    if ner: yt[eqr] = sol[n:]
    slack = b - A @ xt      # for ineq rows
    mu = H @ xt + g + A.T @ yt
    return (xt, yt, slack, mu)
```
